name: Stephanas
title: First Convert in Achaia
summary: Stephanas was a wealthy man from Corinth who, together with his household, was among the first to come to faith in the province of Achaia. He was baptized personally by Paul and devoted himself to serving the saints. Stephanas traveled to Paul in Ephesus to bring news from the church in Corinth.

keyEvents.title: Baptized by Paul
keyEvents.description: Stephanas and his household were among the few whom Paul personally baptized in Corinth, highlighting his special position in the church.

keyEvents.title: First Converts in Achaia
keyEvents.description: Stephanas' household was the firstfruits of believers throughout the entire province of Achaia, which included southern Greece, including Corinth and Athens.

keyEvents.title: Devoted to Serving the Saints
keyEvents.description: Stephanas and his household had made themselves available to serve the believers, and Paul urged the church to submit to such leaders.

keyEvents.title: Visit to Paul in Ephesus
keyEvents.description: Stephanas traveled with Fortunatus and Achaicus to Paul in Ephesus, bringing news and probably also questions from the church in Corinth.

keyEvents.title: Encouraged Paul's Spirit
keyEvents.description: The visit from Stephanas and his companions was a great encouragement to Paul, and he recommended that the church recognize such faithful servants.
